subject.title: fix(memory): search by filenames and paths

question: Should the path-FTS table constant and trigger lifecycle helpers become permanent public Plugin SDK API, or remain internal to bundled memory runtime ownership?
rationale: The retrieval design needs a cross-package seam, but repository policy favors narrow public contracts and only maintainers can decide whether third-party plugins should depend on low-level trigger sequencing.

options.title: Keep lifecycle internal
options.body: Expose a narrower publication operation or internal bundled-runtime facade so external plugins cannot directly suspend and restore schema triggers.

options.title: Support the public API
options.body: Keep the three exports and explicitly document and test their long-term compatibility contract for third-party plugins.

recommendation.title: Keep lifecycle internal
recommendation.body: Expose a narrower publication operation or internal bundled-runtime facade so external plugins cannot directly suspend and restore schema triggers.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the memory plugin/host boundary and is the strongest available owner for deciding whether this seam becomes public.
